filingNote: Filed 2026-08-29 as the spec-filed disposition required by Gate G095 for a discovered issue BUG-012 recorded as 'out of scope rather than done'. Under the Discovered-Issue Disposition rule a disposition is discharged by CREATING the tracked artifact, not by narrating the finding, so this packet exists on disk as of that turn. It is a design decision with defensible alternatives rather than a defect with one correct fix, which is why it is a spec and not a bug.

executionHistory.summary: Filed this packet as the spec-filed disposition for a discovered issue in BUG-012. No scope work was started and no phase was executed, so phasesExecuted is empty rather than populated with claims nothing has earned.

assurance.detail: Nothing has been executed against this packet, so there is no measurement for a validator to re-derive and no delivery for an auditor to attack. The level records the absence of independent verification rather than implying any verification occurred.
